decisions.reason: The mitred handle family is still mentioned two years after launch and costs little to keep in a catalogue-based range, so management keeps this low-cost option open while its prospects remain uncertain.
It moved from a mention to a page of its own in 2024, which signals growing commitment and favourable early evidence, so the option is worth keeping and extending.
It is only mentioned and shows no clear results, but it stays visible and is cheap to keep alongside the established handle range, so dropping it is not yet justified.

The FSB 1289 collection won the German Design Award and the iF Design Award and keeps its own page, so much of the uncertainty about its value has resolved in its favour and further commitment is warranted.
